name: Hornbill Restaurant
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor #1 of 6 in Kaziranga National Park (4.1, 52 reviews). Roadside dhaba style — technically a dhaba, not a restaurant — just before Kohora's main charali on NH 715, with walls painted in Assamese cultural motifs and Karbi-tribal recipes the resort kitchens skip. The non-resort lunch stop on safari days; cheaper than any in-resort spread.
insider_tip: Cash-friendly, simple seating. Best stop after the morning safari (8-9am) — the kitchen has the day's fish in by 10am. Resort guests skip this; that's why it stays good.
signature_address: NH 715, Kohora, Kaziranga National Park, Golaghat District, Assam 785609

name: Maihang Restaurant Kaziranga
why_it_matters: Lonely Planet–listed 12-table roadside spot, 450m east of Kohora's central crossroads (next to SBI Kohora). Tripadvisor #3 of 6 (3.7 — modest rating, but the only Assamese-thali standalone in Kaziranga aside from Hornbill). The Assamese thali sampler at under ₹200 is the cheapest meal in the park area.
insider_tip: Service is consistently described as slow — order on arrival, then go for a 30-minute walk. Banana-heart stir-fry and the duck are the items that distinguish this from Hornbill; if you've already had the thali at Hornbill, come here for the duck.
signature_address: Village Kohora, NH 715, adjacent to SBI Kohora, Kaziranga National Park, Golaghat District, Assam 785609
